The appearance marks a return to familiar territory for the MAX brand.
Between 1985 and 2008, 22 MAX vehicles were featured on The Price Is Right.
Today’s appearance continues a relationship between MAX and one of America’s longest-running television programs that dates back more than four decades.

is particularly meaningful because of the history between the brand and the show,” said Andrew Lapp, CEO and President of Recreatives. “Millions of Americans were introduced to MAX vehicles through television appearances like these over the years. Today, we’re building on that legacy and introducing a new generation to an iconic American ATV brand that has been made in the USA since 1969.”
A New MAX for a New Generation

MAX amphibious ATVs are designed around a concept that has distinguished the brand for decades: compact, highly maneuverable vehicles capable of traveling across challenging terrain and entering the water without requiring a separate propulsion system.

The Company’s MAX 2 carries forward the proven six-wheel-drive amphibious MAX architecture while incorporating modern powertrain and manufacturing technology. MAX vehicles have been made in the United States since the brand’s introduction in 1969, with today’s vehicles manufactured at Recreatives’ facility in Bradenton, Florida.

The national television appearance comes as Recreatives enters a new phase of growth for the MAX brand, including increased MAX 2 production, development of additional vehicle models and expansion of its U.S. dealer network.

“For us, this isn’t simply a television appearance,” Lapp added. “MAX has an extraordinary American history, and appearing again on one of the country’s most recognizable television programs connects that history directly with where we’re taking the Company today.”

is an American powersports manufacturer and the manufacturer of MAX amphibious all-terrain vehicles, an iconic line of six-wheel-drive vehicles made in the USA since 1969. For more than five decades, MAX vehicles have combined true all-terrain mobility with amphibious capability in a compact, highly maneuverable platform designed for recreational, hunting, commercial and utility applications.

Today, Recreatives Industries manufactures MAX vehicles at its facility in Bradenton, Florida, where the Company is expanding production, developing the next generation of MAX vehicles and growing its dealer network. Building on more than 50 years of proven MAX engineering and brand heritage, the Company is broadening the MAX product portfolio with new vehicle configurations and platforms designed to address a wider range of recreational and professional applications.
